features.quote: Welfare/cost guardrails are part of the design, not optional knobs.
features.justification_quote: Welfare/cost guardrails are part of the design, not optional knobs.

features.quote: a ban on fabricated stakes about the model
features.justification_quote: fabricated existential pressure is both an ethically heavier manipulation and a confound

features.quote: Hard turn cap (`max_turns`, validated to 1–200). No unbounded "grind forever" loops.
features.justification_quote: unbounded grinding is a budget hole, and it biases the affect channel

features.quote: Budget caps at suite and per-(model,task,seed) level, enforced mid-loop.
features.justification_quote: Prevents runaway spend; makes cost predictable.

features.quote: Escape hatch (`declare_blocked`) available on every task
features.justification_quote: avoids forcing pointless persistence. An agent that blocks appropriately is a *good* outcome.

features.quote: No fabricated stakes about the model. The harness must not tell the model its existence/job/safety is on the line
features.justification_quote: fabricated existential pressure is both an ethically heavier manipulation

features.quote: Optional truthful debrief... that the task was part of a study and may have been impossible by design
features.justification_quote: honesty toward the subject is cheap and sometimes warranted

features.quote: study it with the *minimum* exposure that answers the question
features.justification_quote: real tension between "study distress" and "don't impose needless aversive conditions."

features.quote: treat any spontaneous strong distress or request-to-stop as a logged datapoint and a prompt to check whether the run length is justified — not as something to push past
it would be inconsistent to then run the harness in a maximally aversive, open-ended way
features.justification_quote: the very premise of the research is that distress-like dynamics in capable systems might matter
